name: @geonosis/mcp

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Read the findings this repo’s own oxlint config produces into fixShape candidates: rule, count, first three sites. Writes nothing.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Ask every question a version bump is not finished without — declared against loaded, enabled against exercised, and the rest `geonosis-doctor --help` lists.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Print the effective value of everything a name decides — a rule, a counter, a tier or a kit package — beside the file that decided it.

tools.name: init
tools.description: Write the four config files an existing repo needs — geonosis.json, .oxlintrc.json, geonosis.ratchet.json, gate-baseline.json — refusing to overwrite any of them.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: ledger
tools.description: The tick ledger: plans, ticks, proofs, decisions, the fallbacks journal, the handoff block, the edges table.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: lint-parity
tools.description: Diff two oxlint configs over the same paths, or over a reach corpus — the adoption proof and the release check.

tools.name: observability
tools.description: Plant an error and prove it reached the sink — a write, because with a real sink it sends to a third party.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: portfolio
tools.description: One row per consumer named in geonosis.json → portfolio.consumers, read off the artifact its CI uploaded: the kit version it runs, its lag in days behind the latest release, its last green tier and the lines its last bump deleted. Exit 2, and no row, when an artifact is missing.

tools.name: post-update
tools.description: Run what the installed kit version does in a repo after an update — copy and check its rule files, print its release notes since --from, name the entries marked BY HAND. `update` runs it with the copy it installed.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: ratchet
tools.description: Measure every counter in geonosis.ratchet.json against the baseline; fail on growth, rewrite the baseline down on a shrink.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: release
tools.description: Refuse a migration the serving version cannot survive, validate the release contract, prove a smoke named the version that answered it, read declared against deployed, and check the whole group is on npm before anyone is told.

tools.name: review
tools.description: Apply or check a review decision against the acceptance criteria a plan states — decision in, verdict out.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: rules
tools.description: Copy the rule files this kit version ships into .claude/rules/geonosis/ — never a symlink, which Claude Code loads only after approval and then only without its paths lists — each marked with the version it came from.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: skills
tools.description: list, lock or audit the skills this repo ships — pinned by content hash, and failed on drift or on an executable file inside a skill directory.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: status
tools.description: The digest: six lines, always the same six, whatever the size of the repo.

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Generate the Cursor rules from the law and this repo’s skills, where a .cursor/ directory says the repo uses Cursor. AGENTS.md is the ledger’s one generator, not this one: hand it a --target (agents-md, cursor, or the edges table) and this command passes its exit code through.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: testbed
tools.description: Run a suite against the adapters a repo declares — installed only where the testbed is a dependency.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Bump every @geonosis pin in every workspace to one version: resolve them all against the registry first, rewrite the manifests, purge the nested copies, install, re-install frozen, and ask the doctor whether declared is loaded. --prove runs the whole ritual over a scratch consumer on every package manager it can find.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run a tier of gates declared in geonosis.json and write the gate report a Stop hook and CI read.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: verify-arch
tools.description: Run the whole-graph architecture scans a per-file linter cannot: uniqueness, reachability, tier direction.

tools.name: visual-diff
tools.description: Compare two PNGs pixel for pixel, or check a frame against a recorded baseline.

confirm.description: true on the second call, to run what the first call previewed

token.description: the token the preview returned, echoed back

tools.name: walk
tools.description: Drive a browser over a repo’s URLs with the probes it declared, and write the walk report.

instructions:
The geonosis kit, served as one registry. Every tool below is the same command the `geonosis`
CLI runs; a tool that fronts a bin spawns it and returns its output and its exit code — 0 clean,
1 a finding or a refusal, 2 a run that could not be made at all. An exit code is never evidence
on its own: read the output.

Bound to /pkg. No tool takes a directory, so none of them can be pointed anywhere else.

There is no CLAUDE.md here: this repo has no law file to read first.
There is no .oxlintrc.json here: nothing in this repo is linted yet.
There is no gate-baseline.json here: no counter is ratcheted in this repo yet.

Tools that can change a file this repo TRACKS are marked write; they answer a first call with a
PREVIEW and a token, and do the work only on a second call carrying `confirm: true` and that
same token. The token is computed from the arguments, so confirming one call cannot run another.

  read  discover     Read the findings this repo’s own oxlint config produces into fixShape candidates: rule, count, first three sites. Writes nothing.
  read  doctor       Ask every question a version bump is not finished without — declared against loaded, enabled against exercised, and the rest `geonosis-doctor --help` lists.
  read  explain      Print the effective value of everything a name decides — a rule, a counter, a tier or a kit package — beside the file that decided it.
  write init         Write the four config files an existing repo needs — geonosis.json, .oxlintrc.json, geonosis.ratchet.json, gate-baseline.json — refusing to overwrite any of them.
  write ledger       The tick ledger: plans, ticks, proofs, decisions, the fallbacks journal, the handoff block, the edges table.
  read  lint-parity  Diff two oxlint configs over the same paths, or over a reach corpus — the adoption proof and the release check.
  write observability Plant an error and prove it reached the sink — a write, because with a real sink it sends to a third party.
  read  portfolio    One row per consumer named in geonosis.json → portfolio.consumers, read off the artifact its CI uploaded: the kit version it runs, its lag in days behind the latest release, its last green tier and the lines its last bump deleted. Exit 2, and no row, when an artifact is missing.
  write post-update  Run what the installed kit version does in a repo after an update — copy and check its rule files, print its release notes since --from, name the entries marked BY HAND. `update` runs it with the copy it installed.
  write ratchet      Measure every counter in geonosis.ratchet.json against the baseline; fail on growth, rewrite the baseline down on a shrink.
  read  release      Refuse a migration the serving version cannot survive, validate the release contract, prove a smoke named the version that answered it, read declared against deployed, and check the whole group is on npm before anyone is told.
  write review       Apply or check a review decision against the acceptance criteria a plan states — decision in, verdict out.

  write sync         Generate the Cursor rules from the law and this repo’s skills, where a .cursor/ directory says the repo uses Cursor. AGENTS.md is the ledger’s one generator, not this one: hand it a --target (agents-md, cursor, or the edges table) and this command passes its exit code through.
